character: A two-zone resort (Kitanomine and Furano) above the town of Furano in central Hokkaido, operated by Prince Hotels. Its inland location is associated with dry snow, and the town offers restaurants and lodging close to the lifts.
learning: Courses range from beginner to advanced (search summary). Reference, confirm: ski school and rentals operate at both zones.
